home_dir.description: The base directory for runtime data, logs, and configuration.

dir_fuzz_enabled.description: Enable or disable the directory fuzzing module.

dir_list.description: List of directory paths to include in fuzzing. Items are flat strings representing path segments or full paths depending on tool expectations, but here listed as simple strings for the config array structure.

urlvoid_enabled.description: Enable URLvoid API checks for ranking and blacklist info.

source_code_scan_enabled.description: Enable scanning source code for sensitive information like passwords and users.

pac_scan_enabled.description: Enable detection and analysis of PAC files.

external_links_enabled.description: Enable detection of external links and frames.

geoip_enabled.description: Enable IP and hosting info gathering via FreegeoIP.

riswhois_enabled.description: Enable ASN, Network range, and ISP info gathering via RISwhois.

spamcop_enabled.description: Enable Whois for abuse mail lookup via Spamcop.

hash_diff_enabled.description: Enable hash comparison to diff code.

open_in_browser.description: Option to open all results in browser at the end.
